text:
Asha Narang: Hey everyone! Asha here — started today on Backend Platform. Mostly remote (IST) but planning to be in the SF office the week of Apr 6. I make tabletop games, ride a terrible folding bike, and I bring a mean homemade hot sauce. Looking for desk recs, foosball challengers, and any lunchtime taco leads. :wave:
Tara Kim: Welcome Asha!! :tada: If you want office days, Tuesdays and Thursdays are the usual hybrid days. A-Desk-7 is sunny and near the plants.
Ben Cho: Welcome!! Foosball captain reporting in — @Asha you in? I'll bring a spare paddle and try your hot sauce. :soccer: :fire:
HR-bot: Welcome to Redwood, Asha! Please complete the onboarding checklist: <https://redwood.example/onboarding|onboarding checklist>. Badge pickup is at the front desk (ID + QR).
Elyse Ramos: Ooh boardgames! We have a small group that stays after work on Fridays (6pm-ish) in the lounge. Bring prototypes! :game_die:
Devex: If your badge doesn't appear in 24h DM me and I'll escalate. Also ping #lunch-plans for taco recs — there's a shrimp place two blocks over.
Tara Kim: Also quick heads-up — spice tolerance poll needed. Who wants to volunteer as the official taste tester? :yum:
Ben Cho: I volunteer as tribute. Also, fridge has a labeled 'hot sauce' shelf for community condiments.
Asha Narang: Amazing, thanks!! I'll swing by Tue and drop off a tiny bottle for testing. Can someone point me to the nearest bike rack?
Tara Kim: Rack's outside the 2nd-floor loading door — bring a lock. See you Tuesday :coffee: 
Asha Narang: Sweet. Thanks all — excited to meet in person and test both foosball and spice thresholds. :confetti_ball:
